segments.text: Ok so, this is the quickstart page in the CopilotKit docs, for Vue with Crew AI Crews. And umm, I have implemented this page in my project.
This is my project, with the server dot ts, main dot ts and app dot vue from the doc, copied as they are.

Moving on to the demo. So I asked the chat which agent framework it is, and uh, it does answer, but from the built-in OpenAI agent, not Crew AI Crews. No step on this page ever connects a Crew AI Crews agent.
So the Vue quickstart link opens the Crew AI Crews landing page, all about React.
And the only code it shows is a Next.js route handler, export const post equals handler. That's not Vue at all.
So basically, the Vue steps are only in the markdown export, and they use the built-in OpenAI agent, never a Crew AI Crews agent.
That's it for this one, kindly look into this issue.
